scope: Exact local Docker image IDs in native infrastructure provisioning
cause: ensureImage split sha256:<id> into repository sha256, attempted pull and swallowed failure; missing immutable local objects were not refused.

after.realDocker: Creates an isolated scratch image and verifies exact existing and absent IDs. No fixture container, registry pull, or live host mutation.

behavior: Local IDs require full lowercase SHA256 and exact docker image inspect identity; inspection failure propagates before the adapter. Registry reference behavior remains unchanged.
limitations: Does not build or attest application image source; the owning application preparation must supply that receipt.
A future prune may remove a local image; provisioning then fails closed until explicit preparation restores it.
